faqs.faq_question: [V2] 1. What is Search & Organic Growth Intelligence?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] It is an 8-week advanced specialization program focused on SEO, Technical SEO, content authority, AI Search, AEO, GEO, Digital PR, automation and sustainable organic growth.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 2. How is this different from a regular SEO course?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] A regular SEO course typically teaches how to optimize websites for search engines. Search & Organic Growth Intelligence goes further by teaching how to engineer visibility, authority and organic growth across traditional search engines, AI search platforms, social search and other discovery ecosystems.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 3. Is this course suitable for beginners?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] It is designed as an advanced specialization. Basic knowledge of SEO and Digital Marketing is recommended.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 4. Does the course cover Technical SEO?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. It covers crawling, indexation, crawl budgets, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonicalization, rendering, JavaScript SEO, log files, redirects, HTTP status codes and technical monitoring.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 5. Will I learn AEO and GEO?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. A dedicated module covers Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, AI citation optimization, citation-worthy content, passage optimization, entity authority and AI search visibility measurement.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 6. Does the course cover ChatGPT and other AI search platforms?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. The curriculum addresses visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot as part of the evolving AI Search ecosystem.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 7. Will I learn Semantic SEO and Entity SEO?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. The program covers Semantic Search, Topical Maps, Topical Authority, entities, Knowledge Graphs, entity associations, brand entities and structured data for entity reinforcement.

[V2] Yes. It covers template-based SEO systems, datasets, database-driven pages, dynamic landing pages, location and comparison pages, directories, marketplaces, automated internal linking and scaling Programmatic SEO.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 9. Does the course cover SEO beyond Google?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. Search Everywhere Optimization includes YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Reddit, Quora, marketplaces, Amazon, App Stores, podcasts and broader social search.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 10. Does the course cover Local and E-Commerce SEO?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. Dedicated advanced modules cover Local SEO at scale, International SEO and E-Commerce SEO, including multi-location businesses, international websites, category and product optimization, product schema and marketplace SEO.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 11. Will I learn SEO automation and AI workflows?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. The program covers automated keyword clustering, content briefs, topical maps, technical audits, internal linking, schema generation, monitoring, reporting, APIs, Google Sheets, Make, Zapier, Python applications and AI agents for SEO.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 12. Can business owners benefit from this course?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. It can help business owners understand how to build long-term search visibility, strengthen digital authority, reduce excessive dependence on paid acquisition and evaluate SEO investments more effectively.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 13. Can I freelance after completing the course?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. The skills can be applied to SEO audits, Technical SEO, Local SEO, E-Commerce SEO, Content SEO, AEO/GEO, AI Search Optimization, Digital PR, analytics and SEO consulting.

faqs.faq_question: [V2] 14. Does the program include practical projects?
faqs.faq_answer: [V2] Yes. Capstone projects include an Enterprise Technical SEO Audit, Topical Authority Development, Programmatic SEO, AI Search Visibility, Digital PR, Multi-Location SEO, E-Commerce SEO, SEO Automation, Analytics Dashboard and Complete Organic Growth Strategy.
[V2] Search is expanding beyond traditional blue-link results into AI answers, generative engines, social search, video, marketplaces and multi-platform discovery.
